mapper.select: SELECT b.BILL_ID AS "billId", b.TOT_AMT AS "totalAmount", b.CNCL_YN='Y' AS "cancelled" FROM TB_BL_BILL b WHERE b.BILL_ID=#{billId} FOR UPDATE OF b
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_CL_CLOSE c WHERE c.CLOSE_YM=#{month} AND c.CLOSE_STAT_CD='CLOSE')
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.RCPT_AMT),0) FROM TB_BL_RCPT r WHERE r.BILL_ID=#{billId} AND r.CNCL_YN='N'
mapper.sql: r.RCPT_ID::text AS "receiptId", r.BILL_ID AS "billId", r.RCPT_DT AS "receiptDate", r.RCPT_AMT AS "amount", r.CNCL_YN='Y' AS "cancelled", r.CNCL_RSN AS "cancelReason", r.CNCL_USER_ID AS "cancelledBy", r.CNCL_DTTM AS "cancelledAt", (r.CNCL_YN='N' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_CL_CLOSE c WHERE c.CLOSE_YM=to_char(r.RCPT_DT,'YYYYMM') AND c.CLOSE_STAT_CD='CLOSE')) AS "canCancel"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_BL_RCPT r WHERE r.RCPT_ID=CAST(#{receiptId} AS numeric)
SELECT FROM TB_BL_RCPT r WHERE r.RCPT_ID=CAST(#{receiptId} AS numeric) FOR UPDATE OF r
INSERT INTO TB_BL_RCPT (BILL_ID,RCPT_DT,RCPT_AMT,REG_USER_ID) VALUES (#{billId},#{receiptDate},#{amount},#{actor}) RETURNING RCPT_ID::text
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BL_RCPT SET CNCL_YN='Y', CNCL_RSN=#{reason}, CNCL_USER_ID=#{actor}, CNCL_DTTM=clock_timestamp(), MOD_USER_ID=#{actor}, MOD_DTTM=clock_timestamp() WHERE RCPT_ID=CAST(#{receiptId} AS numeric) AND CNCL_YN='N'
UPDATE TB_BL_BILL SET RCPT_SUM_AMT=#{receiptSumAmount}, UNPAID_AMT=#{unpaidAmount}, MOD_USER_ID=#{actor}, MOD_DTTM=clock_timestamp() WHERE BILL_ID=#{billId}
